phase: Post-run Sectoral Financial Positions — S1N boundary coverage/explanation diagnostic
purpose: Test a newly identified post-run boundary question: whether an officially published Romania QSA 'not sectorised' (S1N) financial position exists on the same historical F-minus-F1 boundary and can account for the Phase D resident-sector additivity residual, without rewriting historical A-D or promoting the reference mode.

discovery_basis.eurostat_sequence_accounts: Eurostat's institutional-sector sequence explicitly includes S1N in financial balance sheets alongside S1M, S13, S12, S11 and S1.
discovery_basis.quarterly_financial_data_origin: Eurostat states that quarterly financial sector-account data are sent by the ECB.
discovery_basis.interpretation_limit: The existence of the S1N code in the framework does not establish that Romania publishes the exact S1N F/F1 series required by this diagnostic.

sources.relevance: Institutional-sector sequence displays S1N alongside S1M/S13/S12/S11/S1/S2 in financial balance sheets.
Quarterly financial flows/stocks metadata for nasq_10_f; states that the data are reported quarterly to the ECB and, once validated, transmitted to Eurostat.
S1N is a valid sector code labelled Not sectorised.

discovery_basis.independence_note: Eurostat nasq_10_f is not treated as an independent measurement replication of ECB QSA. Eurostat metadata state that quarterly financial flows/stocks are reported to the ECB and then transmitted to Eurostat after validation. Eurostat is used here only as an external framework/distribution cross-check that exposed the S1N boundary question.

source.api: ECB Data Portal SDMX REST API

historical_diagnostic_basis.envelope_origin: Phase C ECB DECIMALS-derived rounding envelope; no new tolerance is selected from S1N outcomes.
historical_diagnostic_basis.historical_residual_definition: resident_additivity_residual = net(S1M)+net(S11)+net(S12)+net(S13)-net(S1), all on the historical represented F-minus-F1 boundary.
historical_diagnostic_basis.proposed_explanation_identity: If S1N belongs to the missing resident aggregation boundary, corrected_residual = historical_resident_additivity_residual + net(S1N,F-minus-F1).
historical_diagnostic_basis.sign_rule: No sign may be chosen post hoc. S1N enters with coefficient +1 exactly because the historical residual omitted S1N from the resident-sector sum.

prerequisites: coverage_gate passes for stock and flow
S1N stock net position is finite for every one of the five historical Phase C failing stock periods
explanatory_gate.pass_condition: For every historical Phase C failing stock period, abs(historical resident-additivity residual + S1N represented net stock position) <= 0.08 million RON + 1e-9 computational epsilon.

result_semantics.if_source_unavailable: NO_REOPEN_EVIDENCE_FROM_S1N; retain historical A-D and PARTIAL_SERIES_AVAILABLE.
result_semantics.if_explanation_pass: S1N_EXPLANATORY_CANDIDATE_REOPEN_TRIGGER_ONLY; a separate future formal reference-mode contract must be preregistered before any complete retest or promotion.
